# OpenIE Research

> Research by David Charlot at Open Interface Engineering, Inc. The thesis: Energy to run is the only true metric of computer intelligence. All other factors collapse to zero. Correctness is the gate, and among systems that pass it, joules alone order them. Each paper has a web edition and a PDF. Energy figures are labeled as estimates unless a named meter measured them.

The catalog holds three research papers, an economics companion paper and two essays. Two product white papers are kept apart from the research catalog. The flagship paper states the proposed Universal Law of Agency as a definition plus a gate: agency first, kinematic bounds second, and intelligence as the derivative of agency in joules. Mixture of Limits is the philosophy: use the cheapest gear that is sufficient, because past the floor (the plateau) more spend does not purchase verifiable progress. A fixed cascade is one instance of it, and so is the σ-law selector. Metabolic Intelligence is the AI product. Klere (klere.ai) is the hardware that builds the Energy Processing Unit (EPU).

## Research papers

- [Thermodynamic Bounds and an Optimal Tempo for Goal-Holding Agents](https://research.openie.dev/papers/agency/): Research paper. The proposed Universal Law of Agency, stated as a definition plus a gate. Agency comes first: a prediction fixed before the act, coupling to the world through intervention, consequence borne, and a joule budget with refusal on a receipt. Kinematic bounds say how fast agency moves per second and per joule. Intelligence is the derivative of agency in joules, read in hindsight off a completed run. Prediction 1 gives an optimal act time for an agent that holds a goal, with a lab protocol to test it. Energy to run is the only true metric of computer intelligence. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/agency.pdf)
- [Metered Commit Gates: Energy-to-Correct-Completion for Agentic Systems](https://research.openie.dev/papers/gates/): Research paper. Notational Intelligence and Mixture of Limits in one systems paper. A proposal may not authorize itself: an irreversible act runs only behind a certificate, and every decision is written to a receipt. Mixture of Limits is the philosophy: use the cheapest gear that is sufficient, because past the floor additional tokens, parameters, or joules do not purchase verifiable progress. Lookup, then Formula, then Solver, then Model is one instance. Systems are ranked by the joules needed to reach a correct completion. A KV260 board reading gives 11,428 pJ per gate cycle at board level. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/gates.pdf)
- [Task Satiation vs. Aggregate Rebound in AI Demand](https://research.openie.dev/papers/satiation/): Economics companion paper to agency and Metered Commit Gates. Task-level satiation holds by definition once a task completion predicate is true: more synthesis on that task buys nothing. Aggregate demand can still grow, because cheaper synthesis opens new tasks and raises total use. The paper separates the two, states hypotheses H1 (spend after completion) and H2 (Jevons in tasks), and gives the data design that would identify them. Capability scales. Appetite per task does not. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/satiation.pdf)
- [The Reality Code Engine: One Lossless Form for Native, Verified, Low-Energy Programming](https://research.openie.dev/papers/rce/): Research paper. Engineering and theory. Autonomous coding is a design space: approaches sit along continuous axes of energy per task, entropy and determinism, verification strength, reuse and compounding, and model reliance, and RCE is one point that optimizes them. A program is a database functional state machine: one Form, P = (S, E, δ, D, λ), and many fits, grounded in Gurevich's Abstract State Machine theorem. The Reality Code Engine (RCE) retrieves, adapts and proves fits, cheapest gear first, as one Mixture of Limits instance. Correctness is the gate and joules are the ranking. RCE is one uniform code ecosystem: intent is written once as a Form, a lossless encoding, and every target is a faithful projection, so invalid states cannot be written and the gate refuses errors at entry. On 10,000 preregistered Forms with a frozen engine and 0 model calls, every Form round trips to identical bytes, every projection is deterministic, every malformed input is refused at entry, and the Python projection replays the reference trace on 9,999. Code from other languages enters by lift, with repair as that entry path (63.7% of 21,320 single-statement Java bugs). The universality thesis, one Form in place of any other language, is stated as propositions with a large N coverage protocol. Economics companion: [The Promised Trillion Dollar AI-Coding Market](https://research.openie.dev/papers/ai-coding-market/). [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/rce.pdf)

## Essays

- [Spell Check is Global: The Future of Computer Intelligence in the Hands of the Many (7B+), Not the Few](https://research.openie.dev/papers/spellcheck/): History essay. People used to pay a premium for spell check. Now it is free and bundled into the editor, the browser, and the phone. A history of that path, from dated prices to the local library in every editor. Technology built for global access reaches more than 7 billion people. Scarcity pricing keeps a capability with the few who can pay. Energy to run is what remains. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/spellcheck.pdf)
- [The Promised Trillion Dollar AI-Coding Market](https://research.openie.dev/papers/ai-coding-market/): Economics essay. The economics companion to the RCE research paper, where the theory and the economics meet. It sets out who projects the AI coding market and what they project: about $3 trillion a year in developer value, company-reported revenue and valuations, token volume, losses, capex and data-centre energy, each with its source and its label. Every projection assumes the space of autonomous coding has one direction: high energy, high compute, per-token rent and the model in the loop forever. With correctness as the gate and joules as the ranking, RCE measured, on held-out test splits with 0 model calls, 520,541 of 520,821 one-token repairs and 63.7% of 21,320 real single-statement Java bugs with the whole file, at hundredths of a reported joule per solved task. Where RCE covers a task, its price falls toward the energy to run it, as Spell Check fell to a bundled zero price. Research paper: [The Reality Code Engine: One Lossless Form for Native, Verified, Low-Energy Programming](https://research.openie.dev/papers/rce/). [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/ai-coding-market.pdf)

## Product white papers

- [Metabolic Intelligence: Budget-Native Compute from Tag to Campus](https://research.openie.dev/products/mei/): Product white paper. Metabolic Intelligence is the AI product. A fixed energy budget is the physical condition of the best answer. Work that would break the budget is refused or deferred. It spans coin-cell tags at the edge to a resource-optimized central datacenter and runs on any compute fabric. Klere (klere.ai) is the hardware that builds the Energy Processing Unit (EPU). [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/mei.pdf)
- [The Search for JouleOS](https://research.openie.dev/products/jouleos/): Product white paper (review and design guide). A review of how secure compute is composed today and a design guide for what a machine must speak if an agent is to be scheduled, metered, and refused. It places the energy-as-resource operating systems that came before, names what they lack, and describes JouleOS: one intent stream lowered onto the coordinate the runtime measured. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/jouleos.pdf)

## Earlier addresses

- /papers/ni/ and /papers/mol/ open the matching part of [Metered Commit Gates](https://research.openie.dev/papers/gates/), with section anchors. /papers/mei/ and /papers/jouleos/ open the product white papers under /products/.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://research.openie.dev/glossary/): Shared terms across the papers, including value of information, evidence classes, and the software reference implementation.
- [About the papers](https://research.openie.dev/about/): One page per paper on what it claims and what it does not.
- [Figures](https://research.openie.dev/living/): Interactive figures for the papers.
- [RCE Playground](https://research.openie.dev/playground/rce/): Educational, browser-only playground running the RCE core compiled to WebAssembly, with no server and no model calls. Layers: code (break and repair with gears), concept (the program as a database state machine, log fold and byte-identical replay), theory (intent bits supplied and found), proof (Z3 and Kani certificate replay), interfaces (every interface assumption checked), compounding (gated recursive self-improvement), energy (estimates and the Mixture of Limits ladder), evidence (500 held-out ladder tasks with Wilson intervals) and translation (one Form to Rust, Python, XState and SCXML, plus brownfield lift). Companion to [The Reality Code Engine](https://research.openie.dev/papers/rce/).

## Optional

- [Klere](https://klere.ai/): The hardware. Builds the Energy Processing Unit (EPU).
- [OpenIE](https://openie.dev/): Open Interface Engineering, Inc.

## Translations

Each paper has translated editions, marked as translations of the English version, which prevails. Pages with only a translated title and abstract say so and link the English full text. URL pattern: https://research.openie.dev/<lang>/papers/<slug>/ with lang in zh-Hans (Chinese (Simplified)), es (Spanish), fr (French), de (German), ja (Japanese), pt (Portuguese), hi (Hindi), ar (Arabic). Example: https://research.openie.dev/ja/papers/rce/
